title: Class 10 Science – Biology Preboard
note: Starter blueprint following the CBSE Science sample-paper sections (A: MCQ + Assertion-Reason, B: 2-mark, C: 3-mark, D: 5-mark, E: 4-mark case-based), scaled to a 30-mark Biology paper. To be refined by agents/blueprint_agent.md.
general_instructions: This question paper contains 16 questions. All questions are compulsory.
Section A has 9 questions of 1 mark each (Multiple Choice and Assertion–Reason).
Section B has 3 questions of 2 marks each. Answer in about 30–50 words.
Section C has 2 questions of 3 marks each. Answer in about 50–80 words.
Section D has 1 question of 5 marks. Answer in about 80–120 words.
Section E has 1 case-based question of 4 marks with sub-parts.
